description: Renumbers up to six controller numbers as a vMIDI stream passes through

inputs.text: Takes the vMIDI stream whose controller numbers are to be renumbered

outputs.text: Carries the stream with any mapped controller renumbered; everything else passes through untouched

notes: each of the six black displays is one mapping, reads --- --- while unset, and cannot be clicked for help
click a mapping display and it reads MAP>MAP; the number of the next controller to move goes into both halves of it, and the capture gives up after 4 seconds
scroll over a mapping display to move the outgoing controller number, from -1 up to 127; at -1 the mapping is cleared and the display goes back to --- ---
channel numbers are ignored, so a mapping catches its controller on every channel and does not change which channel the message goes out on
the first mapping that matches wins; giving two mappings the same input number leaves the lower-numbered one in charge
a controller that repeats a value it sent less than 2 seconds ago is not offered to the learn, although it passes through and is mapped as usual
